description: research/tm1514_recheck_20261106 (protocol PROTOCOL.json, AMENDMENT-1): replicate A3, counted-only. Run as a local counted session on a development host (isolation L0, stated as such; owner's instruction 2026-11-10), audited with ecbench verify --replay-all; no wall time enters any claim and C3 is deferred. Re-measures the ledger incumbent (wwalk x=0.9,g=1,grow=2,seed=run; identical params to research/curve25519_autolab_20261104/multicurve/spec-k24.json) against rho.negation on the same five Curve25519-family k = 24 curves, with 96 fresh public targets per curve (new target_seed, suffix workloads.target_seed:3) and 6 measured rounds. Arms rho-neg-aa and inc-aa repeat rho-neg and inc exactly (determinism, C0 twin identity); rho-plain is the positive control (expected plain/neg near sqrt 2). Replicates A3 and B3 are identical except label, description and measurement.seed (suffixes measurement.seed:A3 / measurement.seed:B3), so A3-vs-B3 on the same workloads is the independent-randomness A/A. Replicate A (run 42269476702) is a dry run and A2 was withdrawn; neither is evidence. Public synthetic targets; no security claim.
